title: Stitch UI design
description: Generate per-phase screen designs (Google Stitch or the html renderer) from the global DESIGN.md right after GSD's own UI-SPEC step, and tell the planner to use them.

fragment.inline:
## Screen designs (gsd-ui-stitch-phase)

If the phase directory has a `design/` folder with `manifest.json` and a `{NN}-SCREENS.md` file, those screens are the visual reference for this phase. Cite the relevant screens by name in task actions, take token values (colors, fonts, spacing) from `.planning/design/DESIGN.md`, and take copy and states from the phase UI-SPEC. Do not invent a layout that contradicts a screen design.

workflow.ui_stitch_auto.description: Auto-accept recommended options in gsd-ui-stitch-phase when run as a hook
